mapper.sql: id, namespace, contentId, editionId, atMs, content, userId, authorName, clientMsgId, deleted, createTime
mapper.select: select from vpn.danmaku_comment where id=#{id} limit 1
mapper.update: update vpn.danmaku_comment set deleted=1 where id=#{id} and userId=#{userId} and deleted=0
mapper.insert: insert into vpn.danmaku_comment(namespace, contentId, editionId, atMs, content, userId, authorName, clientMsgId) values(#{namespace}, #{contentId}, #{editionId}, #{atMs}, #{content}, #{userId}, #{authorName}, #{clientMsgId})
